commonCauses: mismatched JWT secret key
corrupted token structure
algorithm mismatch
investigationSteps: Check JWT_SECRET value in .env file
Inspect token header using jwt.io
Ensure signing and verification algorithms match

commonCauses: expiresIn configuration too short
system clock out of sync (clock skew)
stale user session
investigationSteps: Check jwt expiresIn parameter in sign
Verify server time synchronization
Inspect token exp claim timestamp

commonCauses: frontend did not attach Authorization header
Bearer prefix missing in header
CORS preflight request blocked authorization header
investigationSteps: Check request headers in network tab
Verify frontend authorization header construction
Verify token extraction regex on server

commonCauses: user roles/scopes not attached to request context
auth middleware placed on wrong route
claims format mismatch
investigationSteps: Log req.user in middleware
Verify order of auth check vs role check middleware
Verify user database schema roles mapping

commonCauses: database service is not running on target host
wrong database port configured
firewall blocking database port access
investigationSteps: Check database service status on database server
Verify host and port configurations in env
Test port connectivity using telnet or nc

commonCauses: incorrect database host configured
slow network connection or packet drop
database server overloaded
investigationSteps: Verify DB_HOST env resolution
Check database server CPU and load average
Ping database host from application container

commonCauses: database connections not released to pool
max connections pool limit too low
leaked connections inside loop
investigationSteps: Check open database connection counts
Verify pool size configuration
Inspect code for unreleased clients (e.g. pg client.release)

symptoms: cannot read property query of undefined
commonCauses: database client not initialized during app startup
database connection called before connection promise resolves
investigationSteps: Verify database client initialization order
Check if connection code awaits db connection before starting server

commonCauses: cors middleware not enabled on server
allow-origin header value misconfigured
request origin not in whitelist
investigationSteps: Verify cors middleware is registered in express app
Inspect Access-Control-Allow-Origin response header
Check origin whitelist configurations

commonCauses: origin in request does not match allowed origins regex/array
production vs staging origin mismatches
investigationSteps: Check req.headers.origin
Compare request origin with allowed origins list
Log whitelisted origins on server startup

commonCauses: OPTIONS request returns non-2xx status code
express options request handling missing
preflight response missing required CORS headers
investigationSteps: Verify OPTIONS endpoint response code in network tab
Ensure preflight handling middleware is registered
Check optionsSuccessStatus configuration

commonCauses: credentials requested by client but allow-credentials not set to true
wildcard allowed origin used with credentials (unsupported)
investigationSteps: Check client side credentials config (e.g., credentials: 'include')
Verify Access-Control-Allow-Credentials is 'true'
Ensure Access-Control-Allow-Origin is not '*' when credentials are sent

commonCauses: dotenv loaded after accessing variables
variable name typo in env or code
variable not declared in active environment profile
investigationSteps: Log process.env on startup
Verify exact spelling of variable in .env and code
Check if dotenv config runs at entry point of application

commonCauses: relative path to .env resolved incorrectly
running app from different working directory than node startup dir
investigationSteps: Verify .env absolute path using path.resolve
Check working directory of node process using process.cwd()

commonCauses: database or network service initialized before dotenv.config() executes
investigationSteps: Trace module import order in server entry file
Ensure dotenv is imported and configured at the absolute top of server.js

commonCauses: using camelCase in code but UPPER_CASE in .env
prefix mismatch (e.g. REACT_APP_ vs VITE_)
investigationSteps: Inspect .env file spelling
Trace env usage in config file

commonCauses: missing .catch() block on promise chain
async function throwing error without try-catch block
investigationSteps: Check for catch blocks in promise chains
Register process.on('unhandledRejection') handler to log stack traces

symptoms: cannot read property then of pending promise
commonCauses: forgot to await an async function call
returning promise when value is expected
investigationSteps: Ensure async calls are prefixed with await
Check return types of functions

commonCauses: try-catch block catching error but not re-throwing or passing to next()
empty catch block
investigationSteps: Check for empty catch blocks
Verify caught errors are logged or re-thrown

commonCauses: Express 4 does not automatically catch errors in async handlers
forgot to call next(err) in catch block
investigationSteps: Verify all async route handlers wrap operations in try-catch and call next(err)
Consider using express-async-errors package

commonCauses: body parser middleware mounted after route registration
router registered before CORS middleware
investigationSteps: Check sequence of app.use calls in server.js
Verify express.json() or body-parser is registered before app.use('/api')

commonCauses: error handler middleware missing next parameter
error handler must have exactly 4 arguments: (err, req, res, next)
investigationSteps: Verify error-handler function arguments signature
Confirm error-handler is mounted at the very end after all routes

commonCauses: mounting auth middleware globally (app.use(authMiddleware)) before public routes (e.g. /login, /health)
investigationSteps: Trace route definition files
Check order of public routes vs private routes middleware registration

commonCauses: missing parser for raw/url-encoded payload
payload size exceeding limit
investigationSteps: Check express.urlencoded limit configuration
Check content-type of incoming requests
